entityDescription:
ENVIROPLAN S.A. is an independent private consulting firm that was founded in Athens/Greece in 1990. The office provides a variety of Technical Consulting, Engineering & Project Management Services and is specialized in Environmental Management & Engineering Projects, with extended activities in many EU Member States, candidate states and other countries; Our activity extends to the Balkans (North Macedonia, Croatia, Serbia, Albania, Kosovo, Montenegro), Turkey, the Eastern Partnership Countries (Ukraine, Armenia, Georgia, Azerbaijan), the Mena Region (Lebanon, Palestine, Jordan, Egypt), the Middle East and Central Asia.
Our business model, developed in the past 20 years, consists of marketing the whole range of our services in a local market level, while we target to selected environmental services (mainly for solid waste and water/wastewater) at an international market level. The head offices of the company are in Athens/Greece and in order to run the international activities the company has also established a network of regional branch offices at Thessaloniki/Greece, Larnaca/Cyprus, Bucharest/Romania, Skopje/North Macedonia and Ankara /Turkey where we have also been registered for Turkish branch, under the name ‘ENVIROPLAN S.A. ANKARA MAIN BRANCH in TURKEY’. ENVIROPLAN’s network of strategically located offices enables us to provide timely responses and innovative, cost-effective solutions.
ENVIROPLAN’s mission is to provide specialised high level, professional services in the international market. We aspire to be a progressive consultancy firm in both local and international level, offering innovative, state of the art, environmental management services and solutions. Utilizing our long-term know-how, quality management and business policy, we aim to provide our clients with the services necessary to address their environmental needs in a safe and cost-effective manner. Our vision is to actively contribute to the creation of a sustainable future by maintaining a safe, healthy, and cleaner environment, in balance with economic development and social prosperity.
The firm is internationally recognized for its high level of expertise and has successfully elaborated up to date multiple projects covering many disciplines and providing a wide range of services. ENVIROPLAN has adopted a philosophy of multidisciplinary approach of the technical and environmental subjects, occupying more than 80 scientists and engineers from various disciplines. With innovative ideas, long term know-how and modern data processing techniques, ENVIROPLAN is capable and qualified to work on large projects and complex problems of environmental protection and sustainability.

entityName: GeoAtributo - Consultadoria e Informação para o Planeamento e Ordenamento do Território, Lda.
entityDescription:
GeoAtributo is a company specializing in studies and projects related to analysis, design, evaluation, and implementation in strategic planning, spatial management and urbanism, environment, and sustainable development.
We offer integrated services that provide effective and innovative solutions to the challenges these areas present, primarily focusing on territorial planning and development at the municipal level. A core strength of our work lies in our expertise in geographic information systems (GIS) and information-dependent technologies. Our focus is on strategic planning implemented through territorial and sectoral action plans.
Founded on 2003, GeoAtributo has operated continuously, primarily serving public entities.
Our multidisciplinary team leverages information technologies (IT), particularly GIS, to meet the evolving demands of an increasingly complex and interconnected market. This focus ensures quality and fosters long-term client relationships. Our team comprises permanent technicians and consultants with diverse higher education backgrounds, including environment, landscape architecture, law, civil engineering, forest engineering, geography, geology, mobility, civil protection, information systems, and urbanism.
With over two decades of experience, GeoAtributo possesses extensive expertise in preparing studies, plans, and projects with significant territorial impact. GeoAtributo maintains a Quality Management System (QMS) certified under NP EN ISO 9001:2015, covering ""Consultancy in Planning and Spatial Management, Emergency Planning, and Climate Change."" This QMS reinforces our commitment to service quality and client satisfaction. We also conduct Research, Development, and Innovation (R&D) activities related to the design and development of products and services in spatial management, emergency planning, and thematic cartography.

entityDescription:
Delta Reality (founded in 2009 under the name Diversitas IT sustavi d.o.o. in Zagreb, Croatia,https://deltareality.com/) is a Virtual & Augmented Reality studio with experience in numerous industries with over 200 projects!

As a team, we challenge industry standards, striving to comprehend the reasons behind existing practices and explore opportunities for improvement. We are enthusiastic about integrating various XR disciplines into a single project to forge compelling and impactful experiences.

We prioritize simplicity and tailored user experiences, guaranteeing that our XR solutions are accessible and effortless for all users. Additionally, we pride ourselves on surpassing expectations with each implementation, advancing limits, and providing astonishing experiences.

Our full service approach supports clients from the point of ideation to deployment, covering:

- Production Management
- Quality Assurance
- Software development
- 3D modeling & animation
- Design & Illustration
- Discovery and creative ideation
- Various multidisciplinary experts

We have a lot of experience with implementing VR/AR/XR solutions into:
- industry projects (our clients are companies such as Linde, Frauscher. Siemens, Vailant, Walt Disney, MIT, Samsung, T-Com, MasterCard, etc),
- European Defence Fund 2024 project proposal "CARGO HAWK - Combat Aerial Reconnaissance and Goods Operator for Heavy-duty Aerial Warfare Kit",
- EU projects such as “XR Communication and Interaction Through a Dynamically Updated Digital Twin of a Smart – DIGIPHY” project with University of Zagreb - Faculty of Electrical Engineering And Computing and Ericsson Nikola Tesla d.d. Croatia. 
The goal of the DIGIPHY project is to research and design technologies that enable immersive and intuitive eXtended Reality (XR) inter-personal communication and interaction, as well as the remote presence and interaction of persons and objects in the visual representation of a dynamically updated digital twin (DT), spatially and temporally synchronized with a physical smart space (equipped with sensors and actuators). Prototype XR-applications will be developed for two case studies, to be tested and validated in a 5G network in the laboratory prototype. 
Link:https://muexlab.fer.hr/muexlab/digiphy
Regarding drone solutions Delta Reality had the opportunity to work on the Drone Racing League Simulator and AI Robotic Racing Simulator,which enabled us cooperation with Lockheed Martin in the part of creating a simulator on which AIRR competitors tested their solutions. Also, one of the founders of the company, Mr. Vedran Škarica, is the holder of 1 patent and co-author of 4 patents within Drone Racing League (https://patents.justia.com/assignee/drone-racing-league-inc).

Mission & Vision
Immersea Srl is a pioneering technology company specializing in thedigitalization of marine environments and submerged cultural heritage. Through innovative solutions, the company aims toenhance accessibility to underwater ecosystems, making them more understandable and immersive for the public, researchers, and stakeholders.
Core Business Areas
Immersea Srl operates in multiple technological domains, including:
- Marine Environmental Monitoring– Development of cutting-edge solutions for underwater biodiversity assessment, including e-DNA detection systems.

- Submerged Cultural Heritage Digitalization– Creation of 3D models and immersive experiences for archaeological sites and marine protected areas.

- Advanced Visualization Technologies– Virtual Reality (VR) and Augmented Reality (AR) applications for museums, tourism, and scientific dissemination.

- Remote Sensing & Mapping– Integration of underwater optical mapping and Earth Observation (EO) data for high-precision environmental assessments.

- Scientific Research & Innovation– Collaboration with universities and research institutions to drive technological advancements in marine science.

Key Technologies & Innovations
- e-DNA Sampling & Analysis: Development of filters applicable to DPV/ROV systems for direct in-situ water sampling.

- 3D Underwater Mapping: Optical imaging and digital reconstruction of submerged environments.

- Telemetry & Positioning (Dead Reckoning): Precision tracking of data collection points.

- Data Management Software: AI-driven tools for cataloging and interpreting marine biodiversity data.

- Integration with Space Technologies: Use of satellite imagery and Earth Observation for validation of environmental claims.

Strategic Goals
Immersea aims to bridge the gap betweenscientific research, environmental conservation, and public engagement, leveragingcutting-edge marine and space technologies. By integrating in-situ data collection with remote sensing, Immersea aspires to set new standards inmarine monitoring, environmental certification, and cultural heritage preservation.

We are a Slovenian company specializing in trading, consulting, and providing services in the fields of surface preparation and printing technologies.
Our primary activity revolves around surface preparation using plasma technology (Plasmatreat Openair®), which enables efficient cleaning and activation of surfaces without the use of organic solvents. Additionally, we offer plasma deposition and coating services.
Founded in 1997 as Rogač Plus, Irena Uranjek s.p., we officially transitioned to Rogač Plus d.o.o. in 2010. We have been official Plasmatreat agents since 1998. Our expertise has allowed us to build strong partnerships with industrial companies, universities, and research institutes. We assist in the development of projects, create tailored Plasmatreat solutions, supply equipment, and provide comprehensive after-sales support.
We possess state-of-the-art Plasmatreat test equipment and instruments, along with extensive experience in pretreating and coating surfaces using atmospheric pressure plasma and plasma deposition. Notably, we supplied the very first Plasmatreat Fine Powder Coating unit (plasma deposition at atmospheric pressure) to a Slovenian company, marking a significant milestone in the industry.
As an authorized partner of Plasmatreat, we also have access to a wide network of specialists and their laboratory facilities.
We hold a strong AA+ credit rating, reflecting our financial stability and reliability in the market.

entityName: DZNE - Deutsches Zentrum für Neurodegenerative Erkrankungen
entityDescription:
Dementia is a widespread disease. Dealing with it is a challenge for society and a burden for many families, because relatives are usually the ones who care for people with dementia3). The costs are also enormous: In 2020, they amounted to some 83 billion euros for Germany, according to estimates by DZNE, and the trend is rising4). The crux of the problem is that there are currently no therapies that could stop or at least slow down the disease process. This applies not only to the various types of dementia – including Alzheimer’s – but also to other neurodegenerative diseases such as Parkinson’s and ALS. Although all these diseases tend to manifest in late adulthood, research suggests that the course for healthy aging is set many years or even decades before. In fact, the potential of prevention is considerable and far from being fully utilized: According to studies, around 40 percent of dementia cases worldwide could be prevented – through beneficial lifestyle habits and medical interventions that address risk factors5).
Ten sites
In light of this situation, DZNE was founded in 2009 as a member of theHelmholtz Associationand the first member of the German Centers for Health Research (DZG). Today, it consists of ten sites –Berlin,Bonn,Dresden,Göttingen,Magdeburg,Munich,Rostock/Greifswald,Tübingen,UlmandWitten– and pools expertise distributed nationwide within a single research institute. More than 1,200 professionals collaborate to understand the causes of diseases of the nervous system and to find novel approaches for effective prevention, therapy, and patient care. Worldwide, DZNE is one of the largest research institutes dedicated to these topic. It is funded by the GermanFederal Ministry of Education and Research(BMBF) and by the federal states in which DZNE sites are located**).DZNEis involved in the implementationoftheNational Dementia Strategy for Germany.
Fading neurons
The common trait of the diseases researched by DZNE is “neurodegeneration”, a term that refers to a progressive decline and loss of neuron. Depending on which area of the nervous system is affected, neurodegeneration can lead to dementia, trigger movement disorders, or massively impair health in other ways. Examples includeAlzheimer’s disease,frontotemporal dementia,childhood dementia,Parkinson’s disease,Huntington’s disease,amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS),spinocerebellar ataxia, and age-related macular degeneration.
Transfer to application
Research at DZNE aims at preventing neurodegeneration and significantly improve the quality of life of affected individuals. Thus, DZNE dedicates its efforts towards all aspects of neurodegenerative diseases – from molecular mechanisms to health care and patient care. In order to cover this wide range of topics, DZNE pursues an interdisciplinary scientific strategy that includes various interlinked areas of research: DZNE scientists work together across disciplines and sites, so that new findings can be rapidly transferred into practical application. Within this “translational” approach, DZNE collaborates with universities, university hospitals, research institutes and research-driven companies – both in Germany and worldwide.

Daniela Bezdan’s Contributions to Space Health and Space Biology at the University of Tübingen
Daniela Bezdan has been a key contributor to Space Health and Space Biology research at the University of Tübingen, with a strong focus on multi-omics approaches to studying astronaut health. Her work has resulted in over 15 collaborative publications with the university, driving advancements in space-related biological research.
For three years, Daniela has been actively involved in biobanking astronaut biological samples and data, ensuring their long-term accessibility and utility for space health studies. She has also been a key collaborator on the ESA Space Omics Topical Team, contributing to international efforts in space biology.
Since the establishment of NASA GeneLab, she has served as the first chair of the GeneLab Microbe Working Group, leading research efforts on microbial data from spaceflight experiments. Additionally, she is a scientific advisory board member at BioAstra, the largest private astronaut biobank in the United States, where she provides expertise in space omics and biobanking to support astronaut health research.
